basic_info.description: Top-floor condo in a grand Italianate Victorian in Eureka Valley. This 2BD/2BA + office home blends bold design with classic San Francisco charm. 11ft ceilings & original wood floors set the tone, while Lime plaster walls add tactile richness the hand applied texture catches light & warms each space. Vintage corbels & Italianate moldings deliver architectural depth. Bold wallpaper selections serve as expressive accents, adding contrast & personality to the layered design. Striking coffered ceiling draws the eye upward in the formal dining room, where picture rail molding, detailed wainscoting & built-in buffet add both elegance & function. The skylit kitchen is outfitted with Wolf & Miele appliances, Carrera marble counters, custom cabinetry, Shaws farmhouse sink, & built in wine refrigerator all orient toward a sun drenched deck, where double French doors lead outside. A lush living garden wall brings vibrant greenery into both living room & kitchen. The en-suite primary features a marble-clad gas fireplace, custom Cal Closets, west-facing window, one-of-a-kind double vanity & marble walk in shower. 2nd full bath, deeded 1+ car garage, central heating, tankless water heater & a sunlit layout complete this unforgettable residence near Duboce & Dolores Park, Castro & shops.
